# yii3-tenancy-db

Database tenant storage for rasuvaeff/yii3-tenancy: TenantProvider over a
`tenants` table (yiisoft/db), optional PSR-16 read-through cache, bundled
migration.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-tenancy-db
```

## Rules

- This backend is the ONE source binding `TenantProvider` in DI (the core
  never binds it). Do not bind it again in the application when this package
  is installed.
- Invalid rows throw `InvalidTenantRowException` — never skipped or defaulted.
- Only found tenants are cached; misses always hit the database, so new
  tenants appear immediately. Cache failures are non-fatal.
- Table columns: id string(64) PK, name string(190) default '', status
  string(20) 'active'|'suspended', attributes text NULL JSON object (no
  database default: MySQL forbids one on TEXT; NULL reads as []).

## API reference

### DbTenantProvider

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TenancyDb\DbTenantProvider;

$provider = new DbTenantProvider(
    db: $connection,        // Yiisoft\Db\Connection\ConnectionInterface
    table: 'tenants',       // default
);
$provider->find('acme');    // ?Rasuvaeff\Yii3Tenancy\Tenant
```

### CachedTenantProvider (PSR-16 read-through)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3TenancyDb\CachedTenantProvider;

$cached = new CachedTenantProvider(
    inner: $provider,       // any TenantProvider
    cache: $psr16,          // Psr\SimpleCache\CacheInterface
    ttl: 60,                // seconds, default 60
);
$cached->find('acme');      // cache key: "yii3-tenancy-db.tenant.acme"
$cached->forget('acme');    // invalidate after tenant update/suspension
```

### Migration

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3TenancyDb\Migration\M260704000000CreateTenantsTable` (namespaced since 2.0; register with `setSourceNamespaces()`, table name via `TenantsTableName` from params) (yiisoft/db-migration,
global namespace, loaded via `sourcePaths`). Custom table name via
constructor argument in DI.

### DI (config-plugin)

Ships config/di.php + config/params.php. Binds `TenantProvider` to
`DbTenantProvider`, wrapped in `CachedTenantProvider` when
`params['rasuvaeff/yii3-tenancy-db']['cache']['enabled']` is true (cache from
container `CacheInterface`). Params: `table`, `cache.enabled`, `cache.ttl`.
